name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for roofing businesses?

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for roofing businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO for roofing contractors primarily focuses on keywords, backlinks, and technical aspects to improve search engine rankings. AEO, while still utilizing SEO principles, specifically targets the intent behind a user's question, aiming to provide concise and accurate answers that search engines can easily extract and display directly. This includes optimizing for voice search queries and long-tail keywords that mimic natural language, ensuring your business is the authoritative source for common roofing questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO focuses on direct answers to user questions, especially for voice search, while traditional SEO targets keywords and technical factors for general rankings.
